# Set EWS request fields explicitly and default the remainder

The accepted Rust send request sets MIME content, delivery-receipt request, message identity and Bcc recipients explicitly, then uses ..Default::default() for the remaining Message fields. The historical send/Bcc reviews requested struct update syntax for Message and Mailbox construction; those scoped suggestions were applied. Preserve explicit protocol fields when reusing this form. Default syntax alone does not establish that omitted wire fields are correct. The same review clarified the Boolean name should_request_dsn, which describes whether to request a receipt. This is a local request-construction and naming pattern, not a rule for all Rust values. No serialized request or server exchange was tested.

Scope: rust/ews_xpcom/src/client.
